blurb: Guests fish for rockfish, lingcod, halibut, salmon, white sea bass, bonita, barracuda, albacore, bluefin tuna, and sharks on private or open party charters. Whale watching tours offer sightings of gray, humpback, blue whales, orcas, dolphins, sea lions, and sea otters. Trips vary from 90 minutes to 12 hours and include knowledgeable captains and safety gear.
